META_DESCRIPTION: An executable plan for editing an existing video. Explore {case_count} selected comparisons, with source, proxy, and matched H3 outputs side by side.
OG_DESCRIPTION: Source video. Executable proxy. Generative edit. Explore eight editing tasks in four synchronized views.
HERO_DESCRIPTION_HTML: Turn an editing instruction into a plan you can inspect.<br class="desktop-break"> A scene program makes the edit explicit; a video model brings it to life.
METHOD_PARAGRAPH: Video2Code estimates the source scene. Next-code prediction expresses the requested edit as its successor program. Code2Video renders that program into a proxy and uses it to guide video synthesis.
METHOD_PROTOTYPE: Our training-free prototype jointly realizes reconstruction and program editing in one coding-agent session. The frozen video model receives the source and edited proxy, with proxy guidance limited to the first five steps.
